title: Doug Alt: the portal is real

tellings.quote: says, "Remember that question you asked me a couple years ago?" I said, "Yeah, it's real." >> Who said that? >> Doug Al. He said, "It's real."

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron says on Jesse Michels's podcast that a man named Doug Alt brought up a question Cameron had asked him a couple of years earlier, about a portal. According to Cameron, Alt told him simply: "It's real." If true, it would mean someone Cameron trusted was confirming that some kind of doorway to elsewhere exists.
